notes.title: 🔜 Coming Soon – Demo Update! 🎮
notes.content:
Hey, Misfits!

A new [b]demo update[/b] is on the way, bringing more [b]action, strategy, and story![/b]

⚔️🛡️ [b]What to expect[/b] 🛡️⚔️:

🔥 A [b]dark ritual[/b] unfolds in the shadows of an ominous temple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299120/64150adcb0a7bc9b44d260e134e0bedb05086cb7.png[/img]

⚔️ [b]Kharys[/b] vs. [b]Ellisar Haskin[/b] – A challenging duel where defense is key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299120/efab1ac267e2b622fc61635807bf9858ca286c2a.png[/img]

🎭 [b]Issat & Roegher[/b] – Allies with their own stories and goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299120/4b7176ecd9a9d899ff0104128aff8318b53e2a0e.png[/img]

🛡️ [b]Group Combat Tutorial[/b] – Face Haskin soldiers with your allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299120/5de44a7bec8b707690beef6ba7277b69e00f06b9.png[/img]

This update will further expand the game's [b]narrative[/b], bringing new fights, new characters, and more strategy!

📢 Stay tuned! [b]More news coming soon![/b]

notes.title: 🔄 Demo Update – Controller Support Improvements! 🎮
notes.content:
Hey, Misfits!

I’ve updated the demo to [b]improve controller support[/b], adjusting both the [b]UI tutorial[/b] and the [b]QTE prompts[/b] to display the correct button icons for Steam Deck and Xbox controllers. Now, playing with a controller should feel much more natural!

However, analog stick movement [b]is not yet supported[/b], and the battler status hover (normally done with the mouse) is [b]still not working with controllers[/b]. Because of this, I’d say the demo currently has about [b]90% controller compatibility[/b].

[b]I’ll keep working[/b] on these improvements, and as always, your[b] feedback is greatly appreciated![/b] Let me know if you encounter any issues or have suggestions.

🎮 Try the [b]updated demo[/b] now and [b]add The Misfits to your Wishlist![/b]

I recommend [b]starting a new game[/b] to ensure the updates are properly applied.
